description: Inspect a single URL with the URL Inspection API: whether Google has it indexed, its coverage state, last crawl time, Google's chosen canonical, and a one-line mobile/rich-results summary. Returns a compact projection, not the full raw blob. Use this to debug 'why isn't this page indexed'.

inspection_url.description: The fully-qualified URL to inspect. Must be within the property.

language_code.description: Optional BCP-47 language code for issue messages, e.g. 'en-US'.

site_url.description: The Search Console property. Use the exact form shown by gsc_list_sites: a Domain property is 'sc-domain:example.com'; a URL-prefix property is the full origin with a trailing slash, e.g. 'https://example.com/'.

name: gsc_inspect_url
title: Inspect a URL's index status
